title: Ritual Conduit
summary: Defeat the ritual’s Reborn, expose the Conduit and finish the Noc Juggernaut it releases.
overview: Defeat the ritual’s Reborn, expose the Conduit and finish the Noc Juggernaut it releases.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: The Conduit starts protected with ten Reborn nearby. Six Reborn deaths make it attackable.
At 30% health, the Conduit is replaced by a Noc Juggernaut. Keep the tank ready for the new target.
The Juggernaut uses Energy Conduit seven seconds after engagement, then every twenty seconds.
Both principal enemies must stay close to the ritual site; leaving the leash area heals them and clears hate.
The event’s spawned stages have fifteen-minute cleanup timers. Avoid a long pause during the transition.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
